messages:
Maya: FYI, Snyk flagged CVE-2026-1054 in libuv transitively pulled by our onprem image. Repro: KMS calls spike CPU and audit logs drop on heavy rotation.
Chris: Can you paste the stack trace / package tree?
Maya: here's the vuln path: app -> native-bridge -> libuv@1.42.0 -> openssl binding. Older hw kernels + auditd + KMS calls seem to race.
Olga: This is the same class we fixed in hosted last month? Was that backported to private? 
Dmitri: No, hosted had a runtime shim; private images still on 1.40 family. We need a proper backport, not a shim.
Maya: Priorities: Dedicated customers get a soft-fix (routing to patched variant) quick. For Private/on-prem we must produce customer image builds and a backport PR.
Samira: Customer constraints: acme corp is air-gapped, must consume signed tarball; no outbound patching. We'll need to provide a signed image + instructions for offline import.
Chris: Proposed branch naming: release/onprem/cve-2026-1054-backport. Image tags: onprem-acme:2026.03.15-cve1054-signed
Dmitri: Test plan: unit tests + full end-to-end with KMS toggled, auditd stress harness, and canary on 2 internal customers.
Olga: Anything special for RBAC or audit logging config? The fix changes how we call KMS and may log more context, so we must check retention quotas.
Maya: Yes, we need to update docs and console alerts: audit size + indexing spikes. Add a filter to avoid exceeding observability quotas.
Samira: For air-gapped, I will coordinate checksum and GPG signature. Provide sha256 and sig in artifacts bucket.
Maya: Deploy plan:
```
# branch
git checkout -b release/onprem/cve-2026-1054-backport
# cherry-pick upstream commit
git cherry-pick -x abcdef1234567890
# build image
make build-onprem IMAGE_TAG=onprem-acme:2026.03.15-cve1054
# sign
gpg --output image.tar.gz.sig --detach-sign image.tar.gz
```
Chris: Buildbot: start build now and run canary job `onprem-cve-backport-canary`.
buildbot: Starting pipeline on branch release/onprem/cve-2026-1054-backport. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345
Dmitri: Rollout windows: patch image to internal canaries tonight 00:30 UTC, customer images by Thu EOD if green. Backport PR must include CHANGELOG + rollback steps.
Olga: Rollback plan: revert cherry-pick + redeploy previous signed image tag. Document in runbook.
Maya: Customer comms: send note to acct team with timeline + offline instructions. Samira + Olga to draft.
Samira: I'll drop the signed payload to S3 path /releases/onprem/2026-03-15/cve1054/ and share STS link to account team.
Maya: Final: add audit logging test to regression suite to catch this class moving forward. I'll own the follow-up ticket.
Samira: ack :thumbsup:
Chris: I'll review the PR tonight.
sec-bot: CVE-2026-1054 flagged as high; tracking ticket SEC-4789 created.
Maya: Thanks, team. I'll update thread with PR link and canary results.
